title: Elastic KV Cache for LLM Serving:A Working Reclamation Mechanism, and Why Chunked Prefill Already Closes the Gap
abstract: arXiv:2608.23658v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An LLM serving engine sizes its key-value (KV) cache once, at startup, permanently setting aside a reserve for the worst-case prefill activation. During decode-dominant phases that reserve sits idle, yet it cannot be handed to the KV pool because it is exactly the memory a large prefill needs. We ask whether this reserve is reclaimable, and build a mechanism to test it. Our elastic KV cache lends the reserve to the KV pool during decode and returns it before prefill, driven by the scheduler's one-step-ahead view of the next batch. It is pure userspace on the CUDA virtual-memory path: two physical handles mapped into one contiguous virtual range per layer, so the attention kernel is unchanged and no driver patch is required. It decommits in a few milliseconds and recommits in tens of milliseconds, works with CUDA graphs and prefix caching, and never triggers an out-of-memory event. A static commit of the same memory is unsafe, crashing

translated_title: 弹性KV缓存用于LLM服务：一种有效的回收机制，以及为何分块预填充已填补差距
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23658v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：LLM服务引擎在启动时一次性确定其键值（KV）缓存大小，永久性地为最坏情况下的预填充激活预留空间。在解码主导阶段，该预留空间闲置，却无法分配给KV池，因为那正是大型预填充所需的内存。我们探讨该预留空间是否可回收，并构建了一个机制来验证。我们的弹性KV缓存在解码期间将预留空间借给KV池，并在预填充前归还，由调度器对下一批次的一步前瞻视图驱动。它在CUDA虚拟内存路径上纯用户空间实现：每层两个物理句柄映射到一个连续虚拟范围内，因此注意力内核无需修改，也无需驱动补丁。它能在几毫秒内解除提交，在几十毫秒内重新提交，兼容CUDA图和前缀缓存，且从不触发内存不足事件。静态提交相同内存是不安全的，会导致崩溃。
tldr: 本文提出了一种弹性KV缓存机制，利用调度器前瞻视图在解码阶段回收闲置的预填充预留内存，通过纯用户空间CUDA虚拟内存映射实现快速回收与归还，在不修改内核或驱动的前提下提升内存利用率，并指出分块预填充已能消除该差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an elastic KV cache mechanism that reclaims idle prefill-reserved memory during decode using the scheduler's one-step-ahead view, implemented purely in userspace on CUDA virtual memory for fast decommit/recommit, without kernel or driver changes, while noting that chunked prefill already closes this gap.
